description: Dept. of Fiscal Policy - Excise Duty on locally produced wine - w.e.f. 06.03.2019
reasoning: This gazette notification establishes new excise duty regulations on locally produced wine, which constitutes a regulatory matter under the Excise Ordinance. It creates a new duty rate, specifies application criteria, and rescinds previous legislation, making it a legal/regulatory instrument rather than a government personnel or structural matter.
